## What

Adding focused render-tier unit tests for uncovered React components in
`apps/operator/app/**`, `apps/operator/lib/**`, and `apps/operator-vite/src/**`
so they show in the `/adv` Tests tab. A colocated `<Name>.test.tsx` matches the
catch-all registry globs automatically — no registry edit needed (verify with
`npm --prefix apps/operator run lint:tests` → 0 orphans).

Proven across the `whole-app-test-coverage-breadth-2026-06-14` campaign
(P-016 continuation, 2026-06-19): ~60 components / ~400 tests added in one pass,
all green, 0 deferred. Companion to
[unit-testing-definetool-handlers-at-scale](/internal/docs/agent-insights/unit-testing-definetool-handlers-at-scale)
(the backend handler surface).

**Canonical exemplars to copy:** `apps/operator/app/admin/plans/RunsPanel.test.tsx`
(data-hook + nuqs + stubbed grid/child) and
`apps/operator/app/_components/DecisionLog.test.tsx`.

## The pattern

```tsx
// @vitest-environment jsdom          // ← MUST be line 1 (no global jsdom env)
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { cleanup, render, screen, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react';
import { NuqsTestingAdapter } from 'nuqs/adapters/testing';

let syncResult: { data: unknown[]; loading: boolean };
vi.mock('@papercusp/sync', () => ({
  useSyncQuery: () => ({ ...syncResult, error: null, fetching: false, invalidate: vi.fn() }),
}));
vi.mock('sonner', () => ({ toast: { success: vi.fn(), error: vi.fn() } })); // INLINE — see gotcha
vi.mock('./HeavyChild', () => ({ default: () => null }));                    // stub the unit's children

import Subject from './Subject';

beforeEach(() => { syncResult = { data: [], loading: false }; });
afterEach(() => { cleanup(); vi.unstubAllGlobals(); });

// data is an ARRAY — most components read data?.[0]
```

Rules that hold across the whole surface:

- **Mock the data layer, render the unit.** `@papercusp/sync`'s `useSyncQuery`
  with a module-level `let syncResult` you set per test. nuqs URL state →
  wrap in `<NuqsTestingAdapter searchParams="?x=1">`. TanStack-router hooks
  (operator-vite) → `vi.mock('@tanstack/react-router')`.
- **Stub heavy children** (dockview, virtualized `@papercusp/grid-core` RichGrid,
  editors, IPC, chat panes) — test the parent's logic, not the child. Mock
  RichGrid to a tiny list when you need to assert rows.
- **Plain DOM assertions only.** `expect(el).toBeTruthy()`,
  `expect(screen.queryByText(...)).toBeNull()`, `el.getAttribute(...)`,
  `input.value`, `btn.disabled`. **jest-dom matchers
  (`toBeInTheDocument`/`toHaveAttribute`) are NOT loaded.**
- **Always `afterEach(cleanup)`** (no auto-cleanup) and unstub globals.
- **Cover real branches:** loading / error / empty / populated states, the
  primary interaction handler (fireEvent + assert the callback/fetch fired),
  and guard/conditional rendering — not just "it renders".
- **D-004 skips:** thin route wrappers (`createFileRoute(...).{component}` /
  `page.tsx`), effect-only shells/providers, pure logo/SVG, `editor-demo/*`.
  Report the skip + reason; don't write theater.

**Verify each before moving on:** `cd apps/operator && npx vitest run <path>`
(or `cd apps/operator-vite && npx vitest run <path>`). If a component is too
entangled to get green, delete the file and defer it — never leave a red test.

## Gotchas that bite (this dev box)

- **jsdom `localStorage`/`sessionStorage` throw "is not a function"** on this
  box. Any component that touches web storage needs a Map-backed Storage shim
  installed in `beforeEach` via `Object.defineProperty(window, 'localStorage', {...})`
  (the `AudienceModeSelector.test.tsx` pattern). Or mock the module that reads storage.
- **`@xterm/xterm`'s dynamic `import()` is NOT reliably mockable** under this
  vitest setup — the real module races in non-deterministically. For
  xterm-embedding components (TerminalTab, pty docks), assert only the
  **pre-import** branches (the decisions that resolve before the xterm import);
  the post-spawn embed is an effect-only path with no branch logic anyway.
- **`sonner` must be mocked INLINE in the factory.** `vi.mock` is hoisted above
  declarations, so `vi.mock('sonner', () => ({ toast }))` referencing an outer
  `const toast` throws "Cannot access 'toast' before initialization". Put the
  `vi.fn()`s inside the factory.
- **cmdk needs `Element.prototype.scrollIntoView = vi.fn()`** (jsdom lacks it),
  and cmdk only renders its `<Empty>` ("No matches") when the command list is empty.
- **Async nuqs URL writes:** assert via the adapter's `onUrlUpdate` callback +
  `hasMemory` + `vi.waitFor`. Collapsed Radix groups: seed `?expand=<slug>` to
  mount row content.
- **Partial module mock that needs load-time constants** (e.g. PlansClient's
  `PLAN_BUCKETS`/`bucketOf`): use `await vi.importActual('./module')` and spread
  it, overriding only the fns you stub.
- **`vi.clearAllMocks()` does NOT reset `mockImplementation`** — use `mockReset()`.
- **Debounce tests:** prefer REAL timers + `waitFor({ timeout: 2000 })`; fake
  timers race the seed-fetch promise and leave inputs empty.
- **fail-on-console:** operator-core suppresses `console.*` (fail-on-console);
  apps/operator component tests are looser — but a React "update while rendering"
  warning can still trip a test, so drive onReady/effects via `useEffect`-style
  stubs rather than synchronous render-time calls.

## Where they appear

Colocated `*.test.tsx` under `apps/operator/app/**`, `apps/operator/lib/**`,
`apps/operator-vite/src/**` match the `operator-core`, `operator-ui-lib`, and
`adv` domain globs in `testing-domains-registry.ts` automatically — green chips
in the `/adv` Tests tab with no registry edit. A genuinely new top-level dir is
the only case needing a one-line glob add + `npm run gen:contract`.
